## Publication Information

**Date:** 1859

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i>  (January-September 1859).

**Notes:** Reprinted in <i>Lucy and Christian Wainwright and Other Tales</i> (London 1863). By the Author of <i>Aggesden Vicarage, The Wynnes</i> and <i>Mildred’s Last</i> Night’.
